geometry.note: Genuine axis-1 SILENT, verified: no geometry tables, templates, or TC details in the RDCCM (taper/cone/flagger hits are permanent-design only). MHTs follow the current MUTCD. Edition caution: the Jan 2026 RDCCM still pins 'latest Town adopted edition' to 2009/2011 reference blocks — an explicit-policy pin in tension with the statewide 11th-Ed mandate (preserved, not resolved).

deltas.rule: Vertical panels required for any cut or fill of 2 inches or more within 5 feet of a travel lane, at MUTCD intervals, immediately behind grading/removal operations.
deltas.baseline: MUTCD imposes no fixed vertical-panel trigger at this threshold

effect.note: quantity per MUTCD intervals along the affected length

trigger.condition: cut/fill >= 2 in within 5 ft of a travel lane

source.doc: Parker RDCCM

deltas.rule: At least one lane in each direction shall remain open to traffic at all times in roadway excavations; the Town does not typically allow full roadway closures.

source.doc: Parker RDCCM

deltas.rule: Street plates are generally not permitted year-round — 'contractors should not plan to utilize them'; rare exceptions.

source.doc: Parker RDCCM

deltas.rule: All traffic control that may conflict with snow removal must be planned for removal from roadways in advance of snow events.

source.doc: Parker RDCCM

windows.note: Lane closures: 'Traffic lanes may be closed to traffic, Monday through Friday, within the hours of 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.' (RDCCM §8.7.6.1). No traffic control shall be present on the roadways outside these hours.

source.doc: Parker RDCCM

hours.override_note: Overnight closures not typically permitted — written case-by-case request to the Director; the Town may itself require night work. No traffic interruptions 3:30 p.m.-9:00 a.m. the following day without Director approval. Development construction hours: M-F 7-7, Sat 8-7, Sun 10-7 (weekend-permitted regime). ROW work requiring inspection: M-F 8-5. Emergency utility repairs permitted anytime with adequate MUTCD traffic control.

personnel.rule: Contractor provides the DTA the contact info of the appointed Traffic Control Supervisor, 'if other than the Project Superintendent' — no certification requirement; the Superintendent is the default TCS.

source.doc: Parker RDCCM

personnel.rule: Police and Parker Fire District approval is required for every MHT that closes a roadway for any length of time; coordinate police/fire/ambulance/transit on partial or full closures.

source.doc: Parker RDCCM

devices.rule: Devices per MUTCD, supplied by the permittee; overnight excavations properly marked; the Town may maintain/remove failed traffic control at contractor cost.

source.doc: Parker RDCCM

hazards.rule: Peak-hour lane closures are priced, not banned: $500/day arterial, $250/day collector — 3.3x/2.5x the standard rate. When the closure is scheduled changes the fee.

source.doc: Parker ROW Permit Fee Schedule

hazards.rule: Deposit held to closeout; overrun days and violations deducted; no allowances for weather, staffing, or subcontractor delays — schedule risk sits entirely on the contractor. Third TC offense = termination of permit.

source.doc: Parker Lane Closure Fee and Deposits Overview

notes.rule: The ROW permit trigger is the broadest in the corpus: required for all work within public ROW 'or work that may affect public right-of-way'.

source.doc: Parker ROW Permits page (parkerco.gov)

notes.rule: Written closure schedule filed with the application; the Town agrees a duration; lane-closure fee = duration x daily rate, collected up front. Deposits: arterial <=1000 LF = 50% of permit fee, collector = 25%, >1000 LF case-by-case; cash/check, held to closeout; schedule met = full refund less violations.

source.doc: Parker Lane Closure Fee and Deposits Overview

notes.rule: Insurance: GL $1,000,000 each occurrence / $1,000,000 aggregate; WC/EL 100/100/500; Town of Parker = certificate holder + additional insured, 20120 E. Mainstreet. (Sample sheet drawn from the special-events context — events-sample provenance flag; a ROW-specific limits page supersedes if it surfaces. Auto/umbrella minimums not stated.)

notes.rule: Cross-authority permits are Parker application attachments: 'Permits from any outside authorities (CDOT — working on Parker Rd, E-470, etc.)'.

notes.rule: All restoration within public ROW must be completed within five days of completion of work unless alternate arrangements approved. 72-hour written startup notice; scope growth requires a supplementary application within one business day; subcontractors listed on the application; permits non-transferable without reissue; Equipment Declaration (sales tax) form required.

multi_agency.rule: Parker Rd = SH-83 = CDOT permit; E-470 work requires the Authority's permit; cross-authority permits attach to the Parker application. Parker Fire District notified of any closure of any length.
